name: 10L Int5-MLP + BigramHash(16384, dim=64) + SWA(frac=0.4) + WD=0.04
blurb: 10 layers mixed int5/int6 quantization. BigramHash vocab=16384 dim=64 vs thwu1's 10240x128 — same ~1MB embedding parameter budget but wider vocabulary (16384 buckets). SWA start_frac=0.4, swa_every=50. Muon WD=0.04, warmdown=3000. SmearGate + OrthoInit + zstd-22. Single seed (1337), 7306 steps on 8xH200, 10-min wall-clock. Finding: at equal param budget, wider vocab outperforms higher dim for bigram hash embeddings.
author: Divij Chawla
